query:
-- Create a Scenic Design category
INSERT INTO categories (name, slug, type, description, createdAt, updatedAt)
VALUES ('Scenic Design', 'scenic-design', 'project', 'Theatrical scenic design projects', NOW(), NOW());

-- Get the category ID (assuming it's 1 since it's the first)
SET @scenic_category_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();

-- Insert sample projects
INSERT INTO projects (title, slug, excerpt, description, categoryId, location, client, year, status, featured, metadata, seoTitle, seoDescription, createdAt, updatedAt, publishedAt)
VALUES
('Million Dollar Quartet', 'million-dollar-quartet', 'Co-scenic design for the 2025 production at South Coast Repertory', 'Co-scenic design for the 2025 production of Million Dollar Quartet, featuring the legendary recording session of Elvis Presley, Johnny Cash, Jerry Lee Lewis, and Carl Perkins at Sun Records in Memphis.', @scenic_category_id, 'Costa Mesa, CA', 'South Coast Repertory', 2025, 'published', TRUE, JSON_OBJECT('venue', 'South Coast Repertory', 'director', 'James Moye', 'coDesigner', 'Efren Delgadillo Jr', 'subcategory', 'Musical Theatre'), 'Million Dollar Quartet - Scenic Design', 'Co-scenic design for Million Dollar Quartet at South Coast Repertory featuring Elvis, Johnny Cash, Jerry Lee Lewis, and Carl Perkins', NOW(), NOW(), '2025-08-29'),

('Much Ado About Nothing', 'much-ado-about-nothing', 'Scenic design for Shakespeare''s romantic comedy at New Swan Shakespeare Festival', 'Scenic design for Shakespeare''s romantic comedy set in the American Southwest, featuring live bluegrass music. An outdoor amphitheater production celebrating love, wit, and deception.', @scenic_category_id, 'Irvine, CA', 'New Swan Shakespeare Festival', 2025, 'published', TRUE, JSON_OBJECT('venue', 'New Swan Shakespeare Festival', 'director', 'Eli Simon', 'subcategory', 'Shakespeare'), 'Much Ado About Nothing - Scenic Design', 'Scenic design for Much Ado About Nothing at New Swan Shakespeare Festival', NOW(), NOW(), '2025-06-01'),

('All''s Well That Ends Well', 'alls-well-that-ends-well', 'Scenic design for Shakespeare''s problem play at New Swan Shakespeare Festival', 'Scenic design for Shakespeare''s problem play, exploring themes of class, gender, and agency in an outdoor amphitheater setting.', @scenic_category_id, 'Irvine, CA', 'New Swan Shakespeare Festival', 2025, 'published', TRUE, JSON_OBJECT('venue', 'New Swan Shakespeare Festival', 'subcategory', 'Shakespeare'), 'All''s Well That Ends Well - Scenic Design', 'Scenic design for All''s Well That Ends Well at New Swan Shakespeare Festival', NOW(), NOW(), '2025-06-01'),

('Romero', 'romero', 'World premiere production at University of Missouri', 'World premiere production exploring the life and martyrdom of Archbishop Óscar Romero. A powerful theatrical experience examining faith, justice, and sacrifice.', @scenic_category_id, 'Columbia, MO', 'University of Missouri', 2025, 'published', FALSE, JSON_OBJECT('venue', 'University of Missouri', 'subcategory', 'Drama'), 'Romero - Scenic Design', 'World premiere scenic design for Romero at University of Missouri', NOW(), NOW(), '2025-04-23'),

('Deathtrap', 'deathtrap', 'Ira Levin''s clever thriller at Okoboji Summer Theatre', 'Scenic design for Ira Levin''s clever thriller, a suspenseful comedy about a playwright who will stop at nothing for a hit show.', @scenic_category_id, 'Okoboji, IA', 'Okoboji Summer Theatre', 2025, 'published', FALSE, JSON_OBJECT('venue', 'Okoboji Summer Theatre', 'subcategory', 'Thriller'), 'Deathtrap - Scenic Design', 'Scenic design for Deathtrap at Okoboji Summer Theatre', NOW(), NOW(), '2025-08-01');
